inputs.text: Organizers are claiming 8 million people attended more than 3,300 “No Kings” events across all 50 states—about one million more than in October. Those are their figures, not an official count, and even a large crowd cannot claim to speak for the nation. These demonstrations are pressure politics, not a license to weaken lawful authority or set aside the institutions and traditions that preserve order. In a republic, numbers shouted in the street do not replace law, responsibility, or the consent of the country as a whole.
